lots.dropped_entries: Dropped the PriceCharting grade 8 guide (US$45.50) from SOLD: it is an aggregate, not a single price paid; kept only as context. Researcher rate of 1.50 replaced with live 1.4383, which lowers every AUD figure.
lots.condition: Slab looks clean and intact in the single front photo; card centred, holo surface looks fine. Back of slab not shown.
lots.key_photo_findings: CGA label read: 2022 POKEMON SWSH PROMOS #SWSH260 CHARIZARD V FULL ART - B STAR PROMO, 215633, 8.5 NM/MT+. Card face matches SWSH260 (Illus. Oswaldo Kato, Incinerate 90, Heat Blast 180). Lot sticker 205 also carries faint blue pen notes (looks like 1015 and possibly 30.00), meaning unclear. Lot already has 11 bids.
lots.question_for_gowans: Can you confirm the slab back and edges are uncracked and the CGA cert 215633 checks out on the CGA website?

lots.guide_summary: No surviving evidence of any kind: the researcher found none and my own searches were refused (session WebSearch budget used up). Nothing sold, unsold or asking.
lots.working: No SOLD evidence, so both maximums are 0.
lots.condition: General tarnish and surface wear to bowls; no visible dents or bends in the single photo. Backs and marks not shown.
lots.key_photo_findings: Enlarged the stems and terminals: cast terminals show a draped figure with foliage and ball finial rather than a classic English apostle figure, a style common on Scandinavian/Continental souvenir and 830 silver spoons as well as on plated ones. No hallmarks visible, backs not photographed. Silver versus plate cannot be told.
